name: Stop Loss Take Profit
summary: This EA is a utility tool that automatically manages stop loss and take profit levels for open positions. It does not open trades on its own but instead applies or modifies SL/TP values on existing orders based on configurable parameters. It functions as an order management assistant rather than a trading strategy.
summary_zh: 这个EA是一个工具类程序，自动管理持仓的止损和止盈水平。它不会自行开仓，而是根据可配置参数对已有订单设置或修改止损止盈值。它是订单管理辅助工具，而非交易策略。
strategy_analysis: 此EA属于工具类，不包含任何交易策略逻辑，不会根据市场信号自主开仓或平仓。其核心功能是为现有持仓自动设置止损和止盈价格，帮助交易者统一管理风险。入场条件不适用，因为它不执行任何交易操作。出场条件同样不适用，但可以通过止损或止盈的触发间接导致仓位关闭。仓位管理和资金管理不属于此EA的功能范围，它仅负责为已有仓位添加保护性订单。该工具的价值在于简化手动交易者的风控操作，确保每笔交易都有预设的止损止盈保护。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA belongs to the utility category and does not contain any trading strategy logic; it does not open or close positions based on market signals. Its core function is to automatically set stop loss and take profit prices for existing positions, helping traders manage risk uniformly. Entry conditions are not applicable since it does not execute any trading operations. Exit conditions are also not applicable, though it can indirectly cause position closure through triggered stop loss or take profit levels. Position sizing and money management are outside the scope of this EA's functionality; it only adds protective orders to existing positions. The tool's value lies in simplifying risk control operations for manual traders, ensuring every trade has preset stop loss and take profit protection.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数设置，0表示不设置
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数设置，0表示不设置
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 指定EA的魔术编号，0表示所有EA
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying its orders

parameters.name: ModifyExisting
parameters.description: 是否修改已有止损止盈

pros: 自动为持仓设置止损止盈，减少人工操作遗漏风险
可配置参数灵活，支持按魔术编号筛选或全部应用
作为辅助工具与手动交易或其他EA配合使用，提高风控效率
pros_en: Automatically sets SL/TP for positions, reducing the risk of human oversight
Flexible configurable parameters, supporting filtering by magic number or applying to all
Works as a companion tool with manual trading or other EAs, improving risk management efficiency
cons: 不产生自主交易信号，完全依赖外部仓位存在
无法根据市场波动动态调整止损止盈水平
缺少对仓位类型的区分处理（多空可能需要不同止损距离）
cons_en: Does not generate autonomous trading signals, entirely dependent on existing external positions
Cannot dynamically adjust SL/TP levels based on market volatility
Lacks differentiated handling for position types (long/short may need different stop distances)
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈计算功能，根据市场波动自适应调整
增加多空方向分别设置不同止损止盈距离的功能
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic SL/TP calculation to adapt stop distances to market volatility
Add functionality to set different SL/TP distances for long and short positions separately

risk_points: 如果止损设为0则不会添加保护，可能导致无止损持仓
参数配置错误可能导致止损止盈距离过小被滑点穿越
risk_points_en: If StopLoss is set to 0, no protection is added, potentially leaving positions unprotected
Misconfigured parameters may result in SL/TP distances too small to be effective against slippage
